Cheers,

Active paid Team plan gives some residual intent, so a small chance of self-starting within the 8 remaining days.

draft.subject: A hand with Granite Group's first project
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

I know a few notes from us have landed in your inbox already, so I'll keep this short. Nothing is set up on Granite Group's account yet, and the first step is usually the smallest one: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project tends to make the rest click.

Would a 15-minute call this week work? I'll sit with you while we create that first project with your actual tasks, and answer anything else as we go. If email is easier, just reply and I'll walk you through it.

Best,
Priya
